interface.longDescription: Twenty-six focused SEO skills for reviewing websites, planning improvements, and interpreting evidence. Covers technical SEO, page and content reviews, structured data, local and international search, GEO, e-commerce, site monitoring, and optional external data workflows. Recommendations state evidence and limitations; external provider access is never assumed.
